parts.label: (a)
parts.note: q² = (p+2r)/(p−r) → q²p − q²r = p + 2r → p(q² − 1) = r(q² + 2) → p = r(q²+2)/(q²−1); both give this.

parts.label: (b)
parts.note: 8 × 11 / 8 = 11; check √(27/3) = 3. Both give p = 11 (direct substitution 9(p−8) = p+16 also gives 11).

key_verdict: No disagreement — the key is correct in both parts.
why: Formula on its own line, the exact SEAB imperative, subject twice inside a square root so the route is square → clear the fraction → collect → factorise (3 marks, the same weight as 2025 P1 Q18), and a 1-mark substitution with numbers that cancel to an integer; it mirrors the 2018 x² exemplar's skill without re-skinning it.
